rca of the issue: The dispatch KPI heavy-chrome appears to be a missed file in the iter317c→iter321 family-contract refactor — the other 8 hubs were normalized but DispatchHub.jsx KPI strip retained the legacy `border-2 border-slate-300` styling. Reproduction: visit /dispatch-portal as super-admin → top KPI strip shows two cards with thicker borders distinct from the neutral pattern. Mitigation: replace the 2 card classNames in DispatchHub.jsx with the same `border-l-4 border-l-<color> bg-white border border-slate-200` pattern used by /hr KPI strip.
